parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Listening
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Choose the correct answer (a, b or c).

parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: Are you sure you want to get marry to George? You only met him four months ago.
I hope I haven’t losed my phone. I had it in my trouser pocket this morning but now I can’t find it.
I’ve never swam in that river because there are lots of fish in it, and I don’t want them to touch me.
If you’re not feeling well, just get your bed. I’ll bring you some cold medicine and a cup of lemon tea.
Which radio station are you listening at?
How much physical exercise do you make each week?
If you’re feeling tired, I suggest you drinking some coffee.
Why did you decide buying chocolates for me? It’s not my birthday.
I don’t like monkeys. I’m afraid from them.

parts.text: A bike is either a bicycle or a motorbike. The future of “you go” is “you will go”. We use ice for putting in drinks to cool them. The duration of a football match is ninety minutes. The opposite of “heaven” is “hell”. The past of “have” is “had”. The plural of “wife” is “wives”. The opposite of the verb “to lose” is “to find”. We find a keyhole in a door. A painter holds a paintbrush in his hand. The three forms of “sing” are “sing, sang, sung”. A film star is a famous actor or actress. The only meal I can’t go without is breakfast. We walked along the river for about an hour.
